response.sql: SELECT rep_counts.City, SUM(rep_counts.customer_count) as total_customers, AVG(rep_counts.customer_count - city_avgs.city_avg) as avg_above_city_average, AVG(rep_counts.customer_count) / SUM(rep_counts.customer_count) as avg_share FROM (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(c.CustomerId) as customer_count FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City) rep_counts JOIN (SELECT City, AVG(customer_count) as city_avg FROM (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(c.CustomerId) as customer_count FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City) sub GROUP BY City) city_avgs ON rep_counts.City = city_avgs.City WHERE rep_counts.customer_count > city_avgs.city_avg GROUP BY rep_counts.City
